description:
Cast Jirina Kudro by paying {1}{R}{W}{B}.
When Jirini Kudro enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, creating two 1/1 Human Soldier tokens due to Anointed Procession.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Human Soldier tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Jirina Kudro, adding {W}.
Choose to return Jirina Kudro from your graveyard to the command zone.
Cast Jirina Kudro by paying {3}{R}{W}{B}.
When Jirini Kudro enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, creating four 1/1 Human Soldier tokens due to Anointed Procession.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Human Soldier tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing two Human Soldier tokens and Jirina Kudro, adding {R}{W}{B}.
Repeat from step 5, except that you pay more commander tax each time in step 6, create more Human Soldier tokens in step 7, and sacrifice as many creatures as necessary to pay commander tax in step 8.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Human Soldier tokens, you may activate Ashnod's Altar and Phyrexian Altar any number of times.
